title: ROLE COMPASS INTRO
description: New characters now get a clean role compass that explains tanking, healing, crafting, racing, farming, and dungeon jobs before the first objective is chosen.
consequence: The map learns how to introduce a continent.

title: HONEST SCOPE WARNING
description: The new game screen now explains expected session length, base upkeep, extraction risk, crafting depth, and how much spreadsheet weather the frontier contains.
consequence: The welcome sign includes the mountain.

title: FEATURED STARTER LOADOUT
description: The opening screen now pushes one loud featured build with creator tags, neon role badges, three weapon nicknames, and a giant recommended stamp over the details.
consequence: The first loadout arrives wearing campaign paint.

title: ARCHIVE-FIRST TUTORIAL
description: The tutorial now opens with faction history, relic families, and seasonal card identities before easing into the basic turn flow.
consequence: The first lesson starts on chapter two.
